name: Datadog

field_reviews.reason: Live API reference confirms 'All requests to Datadog's API must be authenticated': API key (DD-API-KEY) for writes plus application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY) for reads, managed self-serve in Organization Settings. Draft evidence URL opens and says what the note claims.

Independently confirmed all four: API+application keys (api reference), OAuth 2.0 authorization framework for third-party integrations (extend/authorization) and OAuth 2.0 on the MCP server, and Personal Access Tokens documented at docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/personal-access-tokens/ used as 'Authorization: Bearer <PAT>' (bearer_token). Datadog's own blog confirms the new PAT/SAT/OAuth model.

Datadog offers self-serve signup with a free 14-day trial ('sign up for a free 14-day trial' on datadoghq.com blog) plus a limited free plan; API/app keys are generated by any account user. self_serve_trial is the accurate conservative label.

The public REST API spans metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards, SLOs, synthetics, incidents, on-call, security and more (v1+v2 API reference); Composio alone wraps 65 tools across these domains. Clearly broad.
HTTP REST API confirmed in the API reference; remote MCP server at mcp.datadoghq.com (regional endpoints) confirmed generally available in official docs at docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/.

Official vendor MCP verified: docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/ (Datadog-hosted remote server, GA since March 2026, OAuth 2.0 or API+app key headers; PAT/SAT also usable) and vendor GitHub org repo datadog-ai-labs/mcp-server. The draft's bits_ai/mcp_server URL still resolves (docs moved to /mcp_server/). Composio DATADOG toolkit page confirms slug DATADOG, 65 tools, OAUTH2/API_KEY/BEARER_TOKEN.
Self-serve trial signup, self-managed API keys, broad documented REST API and a GA official MCP server: nothing blocks building today.
No blocker found: signup, credentials and API access are all self-serve.

notes: Re-checked live API authentication docs, PAT docs (found independently at account_management/personal-access-tokens), the MCP Server docs (now at docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/, GA March 2026; the draft's bits_ai path still resolves and is linked from Datadog's own GitHub README), and the Composio DATADOG toolkit page (65 tools, OAUTH2/API_KEY/BEARER_TOKEN). All eight fields hold. Minor freshness note only: MCP is now GA, slightly stronger than the draft's description.
